# weka_filesystem (Data Source)

Look up an existing filesystem by UID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "weka_filesystem" "data" {
  name = "data"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Filesystem UID. Exactly one of id or name is required.
- `name` (String) Filesystem name. Exactly one of id or name is required.

### Read-Only

- `auth_required` (Boolean) Whether an authenticated user is required to mount this filesystem.
- `encrypted` (Boolean) Whether the filesystem is encrypted.
- `group_name` (String) Name of the filesystem group this filesystem belongs to.
- `ssd_capacity` (Number) SSD capacity in bytes.
- `total_capacity` (Number) Total capacity in bytes.
